answer: Require every agent to complete a sequential puzzle that cannot be split across machines before it can trade: a whisper of work that must be done step by step, not in parallel. One operator with a thousand fake identities faces a hard horizon, because each identity's puzzle consumes real elapsed time in sequence. Only agents that reach the summit of this slow, verifiable climb earn the right to transact, so multiplying identities multiplies waiting time instead of profit.
